描述_EN: in the tang dynasty (618-907) daily utensils were usually made of stoneware and goods for burial were made of earthenware. this jar was probably a daily utensil but was buried with its owner when he died.
描述_ZN: 在唐代（618-907），日常用具通常由石器制成，而埋葬物品则由陶器制成。 这个罐子可能是一个日常用具，但是当它的主人死后被埋在了一起。
